templates.name: Label Pill
templates.description: A small measurement or count riding on the footage: '930 · FEET'.

templates.name: Dual Labels
templates.description: Two boxed labels with a dotted connector for two things contrasted in one line.

templates.name: Kicker
templates.description: A short typed line in the top-left corner for a place and date said in passing.

templates.name: Kinetic Title
templates.description: A line rising word by word in condensed display caps with a kicker and an accent rule.

templates.name: Question
templates.description: The narration's question, typed and held.

templates.name: Word Type
templates.description: One or two words typed large in caps.

templates.name: Highlight Sentence
templates.description: The thesis of a section, words appearing left to right with the key words boxed.

templates.name: Key Phrase
templates.description: Only the important phrase of the line, bold, over the footage.

templates.name: Warning Strip
templates.description: A red strip with caps for an alert level or a dangerous state.

templates.name: Memo Box
templates.description: A typed memo box for a note-like line.

templates.name: Underline Title
templates.description: A title with an animated underline.

templates.name: Bar Title
templates.description: A title on a bar that slides in.

templates.name: Swoosh Title
templates.description: A title with a hand-drawn swoosh underline.

templates.name: Chapter (Ghost Word)
templates.description: A chapter title with a giant translucent word drifting behind it.

templates.name: Chapter (Editorial)
templates.description: A serif editorial chapter card.

templates.name: Title Card
templates.description: The plain bold title card.

templates.name: Banner
templates.description: A full-width banner headline.

templates.name: Breaking Headline
templates.description: A breaking-news style chyron.

templates.name: Lower Third (Tag)
templates.description: Name and role on a small tag.

templates.name: Lower Third (Line)
templates.description: Name over a thin line.

templates.name: Lower Third (Serif)
templates.description: A serif documentary lower third.

templates.name: Big Counter
templates.description: One large number counting up to the figure the line is about.

templates.name: Percentage
templates.description: A percentage with its animated bar and the noun it belongs to.

templates.name: Number Roll
templates.description: Digits rolling into place.

templates.name: Increase / Decrease
templates.description: A figure with an arrow for a rise or a fall: '↓ 12 FT'.

templates.name: Ring Stat
templates.description: A radial ring filling to a percentage, riding on the footage.

templates.name: Donut
templates.description: A donut chart of one share.

templates.name: Dot Grid
templates.description: A hundred dots filling to the share, the percentage beside them.

templates.name: Level Bar
templates.description: A wide bar filling to the share, the number riding its end.

templates.name: Stat Pill
templates.description: A glass pill low on the footage: the number, an accent rule, the words it counts.

templates.name: Number and Line
templates.description: The number on the left, what it counts in big type on the right.

templates.name: Progress Bar
templates.description: A bar filling to a level against its maximum.

templates.name: Bar Chart
templates.description: Two to five bars growing from zero, for values compared.

templates.name: Line Chart
templates.description: A line drawing point to point through the years, each value popping as the line passes, the last one rolling with the change in a pill.

templates.name: Area Chart
templates.description: The line chart with the area under it filled in the accent.

templates.name: Ranking
templates.description: Ranked rows sliding in: number, name, a bar growing to its value, the leader in the accent.

templates.name: Pictogram Counter
templates.description: Rows of pictograms, the counted share recoloured: 'N of M'.

templates.name: Scale Comparison
templates.description: Two or three quantities as circles drawn to scale, the ratio between them.

templates.name: Comparison
templates.description: Two labelled values side by side: '2020: 40%  2026: 26%'.

templates.name: Two Boxes
templates.description: Two dark boxes joined by a dashed line, a value in each.

templates.name: Split Screen
templates.description: Two visuals top and bottom.

templates.name: Timeline
templates.description: Nodes on a line drawing left to right, a label at each.

templates.name: Timeline (Ruler)
templates.description: A ruler-style timeline.

templates.name: Year Roll
templates.description: Years rolling to the one named.

templates.name: Span
templates.description: A span between two dates.

templates.name: Numbered Steps
templates.description: Numbered steps on a curve.

templates.name: Progress Steps
templates.description: Steps filling in order.

templates.name: Date Stamp
templates.description: A small date stamp in the corner.

templates.name: Date Card
templates.description: A full date card: 'SEPTEMBER 23 / 2026'.

templates.name: Age Tag
templates.description: An age or a count of years.

templates.name: Clock Badge
templates.description: A time of day badge.

templates.name: Location Zoom
templates.description: Zoom from space to the place, pin and label.

templates.name: Location Pulse
templates.description: Zoom to the place with an alert pulse.

templates.name: Disaster Map
templates.description: Night-graded satellite zoom for a disaster or a weather event.

templates.name: Tilted Landing
templates.description: The camera tilts into a 3D angle as it lands.

templates.name: Route (Satellite)
templates.description: Two places, a path drawn between them over satellite imagery.

templates.name: Route (Dark)
templates.description: A red arc drawing between two places on a near-black map.

templates.name: Route (Paper)
templates.description: A route on a paper map.

templates.name: Distance
templates.description: Two places and the straight-line distance between them.

templates.name: Region Highlight
templates.description: A state or country filled and labelled.

templates.name: Multi-Location
templates.description: Every named state or country lights up in turn.

templates.name: Multi-Location (Dark)
templates.description: The spread map on a dark base.

templates.name: Location with Inset
templates.description: Zoom with a small locator map in the corner.

templates.name: Marker
templates.description: A simple pin on a vector map.

templates.name: Paper Map
templates.description: A paper-look locator map.

templates.name: Dark Map
templates.description: A dark vector locator map.

templates.name: Arrow
templates.description: An arrow pointing at something on screen with a short label.

templates.name: Highlight Box
templates.description: A box drawn around the thing named.

templates.name: Icon Pop
templates.description: A pictogram that pops with its label.

templates.name: Bullets
templates.description: Three short points revealed one by one over the footage.

templates.name: Quote Card
templates.description: The quoted words with their speaker.

templates.name: Article Card
templates.description: A newspaper or report card with the key phrase highlighted.

templates.name: Paper Record
templates.description: A paper archival record.

templates.name: Framed Photo
templates.description: The photo drops in with a white border and a slight turn onto a blurred copy of itself, a typed caption below.

templates.name: Photo on Graph Paper
templates.description: The photo pinned on graph paper with a dashed outline and a typed caption.

templates.name: Place Photo
templates.description: The place's photo full frame, a location pin drops, the name and its coordinates slide up.

templates.name: Object Spotlight
templates.description: The photo of a thing floating on a dark spotlight, turning slowly, its name on a leader line.

templates.name: Photo Stack
templates.description: Up to three photos dropping onto a pile one after another.

templates.name: Person Card
templates.description: A round portrait on an accent disc slides in; the name in big condensed caps, the role in a tag.

templates.name: Water Tank
templates.description: A percentage as a tank of water filling to its level, the surface rippling, the number rolling beside it.

templates.name: Pie Slice
templates.description: A percentage as a pie: the slice sweeps round and eases out of the pie.

templates.name: Trend Line
templates.description: A rise or a fall: a trend line races across the frame, red down or green up, the amount rolling in a panel.

templates.name: Money Stack
templates.description: Money: bundles of bills drop onto stacks while the amount rolls beside them.

templates.name: Ruler Level
templates.description: A height or a depth on a ruler: the level falls or rises by the amount, the lost band hatched.

templates.name: People Ratio
templates.description: '1 in 4': a row of people pops in and the counted ones light up, the ratio rolling beneath.

templates.name: Shares Bar
templates.description: Parts of a whole: a 100% bar filling segment by segment, each share rolling above its part.

templates.name: Pie Chart
templates.description: Parts of a whole as a pie, slices sweeping in turn, the first easing out, a legend rolling beside it.

templates.name: Versus
templates.description: Two values on two panels sliding in from their sides, a VS badge popping between, the ratio beneath.

templates.name: Before and After
templates.description: The earlier value small above, an arrow drawing down, the new value big, the change in a pill.

templates.name: Tile Columns
templates.description: Two to four values as columns of tiles stacking up, the biggest in the accent.

templates.name: Bubbles to Scale
templates.description: Quantities as circles drawn to scale growing in turn, the ratio between them.

templates.name: Photo Window
templates.description: The photo in a floating viewer window on a flowing dotted desktop, its caption in an info window.

templates.name: Evidence Photo
templates.description: The photo full frame in black and white with grain, viewfinder brackets closing in, a small [ PHOTO ] tag.

templates.name: Photo Window on Footage
templates.description: A small photo window of the place or thing named, riding on the footage with its caption.

templates.name: Detective Board
templates.description: The photo pasted on paper, circled in red marker, an arrow to a handwritten note; two or three photos get hand-drawn links.

templates.name: Case Collage
templates.description: The story's own pictures bursting onto a red desk in photo windows, one after another.

templates.name: Recording
templates.description: A recording playing in an audio window: the waveform moving, the words appearing below, the speaker's photo beside it.

templates.name: Quote Callout
templates.description: The quoted words in a compact dark box near the top, word by word, the speaker under it.

templates.name: Report Window
templates.description: A report page in a document window on the desk, its key line marked with a highlighter.

templates.name: Newspaper Clipping
templates.description: A newspaper page landing on the desk: the headline, a black-and-white photo, the key sentence highlighted.

templates.name: Facts Card
templates.description: A portrait fading into the dark on the right, the points listed on the left under a heading.

templates.name: Dossier
templates.description: A file window on the red desk: the fields typed in beside a scanned photo, a stamp coming down.

templates.name: Source Tag
templates.description: A small outlined label low left on the footage: ARCHIVE FOOTAGE and its year.

templates.name: Location Focus
templates.description: A teal night-graded satellite zoom, a white box drawn round the place, its name in a pill beneath.

templates.name: Location with Photo
templates.description: Zoom to the place and pin it, then a framed photo of the place pops up on a leader line.

templates.name: Route Trace
templates.description: Two places on the teal satellite grade, a dashed cyan route between glowing dots, the miles in brackets.

templates.name: Accent Line Name
templates.description: A glowing accent line grows low-left with a bright node riding its head. The name rises letter by letter out of the line and the role drops out beneath it, then a glint runs along the line; at the end both sink back into the line and it retracts to the right.

templates.name: Two-Tone Name Blocks
templates.description: The name sits on a white block with an accent edge that wipes in from the left, and the role sits on an accent block that wipes in from the right. Both have hard cut-out shadows and drift apart slightly while they hold, then collapse back toward the sides they came from.

templates.name: Glass Name Card
templates.description: A frosted-glass card tilts up into place in 3D and floats gently. A gold icon circle pops in, draws its ring and person glyph, the name and role rise letter by letter, and a diagonal shine sweeps across the glass before the card tips away.

templates.name: Location Pin Drop
templates.description: A map pin drops in, squashes and hops on landing, and ground ripples keep pulsing under its tip. The place name rises letter by letter with the region in accent caps, a hairline draws, and the real coordinates decode in mono: digits scramble in cyan, then lock.

templates.name: Date And Place
templates.description: A glowing accent divider grows from its centre. The date slides out of it to the left and the place slides out of it to the right, both in mono caps with small DATE and LOCATION captions and a hairline beneath; at the end they slide back into the divider as it closes.

templates.name: Initials Role Badge
templates.description: A gold coin with the person's initials flips in on its Y axis with a slight overshoot, its accent ring draws on and a dashed orbit ring keeps turning. The name rises letter by letter beside it and the role wipes open inside an outlined pill; at the end the coin flips away.

templates.name: Corner Bracket Tag
templates.description: A tiny top-left tag with four accent corner brackets that lock onto the text from outside with an overshoot and a glow flash. A scan line passes through it, a status dot blinks, the brackets breathe while it holds, and they spring back open as the letters drop out.

templates.name: Stacked Index Profile
templates.description: A large outline index number rolls in like an odometer and then fills with accent colour behind a moving wave. An accent bar grows beside it, and the name, role and organisation rows slide up out of their masks one after another, split by hairlines that draw in.

templates.name: Slant Bar Drawer
templates.description: A compact skewed accent bar whips in from the left, trailing speed streaks and led by a white sliver, and the name rises letter by letter inside it. A thin dark role drawer then drops out from under the bar, a glint crosses it, and the bar whips out to the right.

templates.name: Source Credit Line
templates.description: A small bottom-right credit line reading FOOTAGE: SOURCE in mono caps, its characters rising and fading in one by one. Beside it sits a play icon whose ring draws on, then an accent progress arc fills slowly as the shot plays; the characters drop out right to left at the end.

templates.name: Word Stack Slam
templates.description: Two to four condensed words stack on the left, each dropping from 1.8x scale and landing with a speed streak, an outline shockwave and a small camera shake. An accent spine grows beside the stack as each word lands, the key word is in the accent, and at the end the words wipe out one by one.

templates.name: Split Line Reveal
templates.description: A hairline with end ticks draws out from the centre, then splits into two rules that move apart while the headline slides up out of the gap between them. An accent glint runs along the rules, and at the end the gap closes over the text and the line pulls back to the centre.

templates.name: Wipe Bar Reveal
templates.description: An After Effects block reveal in the lower left: an accent bar wipes across each headline line and pulls away to leave the words behind, with a white bar doing the same for the subtitle and an accent spine beside them. At the end the bars wipe back over the text and carry it away.

templates.name: Keyword Scale Pop
templates.description: A bold sentence near the bottom centre rises word by word out of masks. Then the key word grows about 1.36x in the accent, the other words move aside to make room, and an accent underline and a ring of eight spark strokes burst out. At the end the words rise back out of their masks.

templates.name: Focus Pull Title
templates.description: Words come from a soft, scaled-up blur into sharp focus one after another, with rimmed bokeh discs drifting in parallax behind them. Camera focus brackets close in and flash the accent when the last word is sharp. At the end the words go soft again and fall back into depth.

templates.name: 3D Letter Flip
templates.description: A top-centre headline whose letters roll in one after another on the X axis like the faces of a cube, in perspective with shading, overshooting slightly before they settle. An accent bar and a tracked subtitle follow underneath, and at the end the letters roll away in turn.

templates.name: Outline To Fill
templates.description: On a slowly settling navy backdrop of dotted ridges, a stroked title rises in letter by letter, then fills with solid white (the key word in the accent) from left to right behind a slanted glinting edge while an accent glow builds. An accent rule and a tracked subtitle follow.

templates.name: Marker Sweep
templates.description: An editorial headline in heavy near-black sans on warm fibred paper rises word by word. Then a translucent, rough-edged accent highlighter sweeps behind the key words with its tip leading, under an accent-square kicker, with a source line below. At the end the highlighter lifts off and the words rise away.

templates.name: Center Stack Title
templates.description: A centred three-weight stack: a widely tracked accent kicker, a big condensed title rising letter by letter, and a light note line. Fading hairline rules above and below the title draw outward from accent diamonds, and at the end everything leaves in turn as the rules pull back to the centre.

templates.name: Ticker Slide
templates.description: A compact, skewed accent band slides in from the left in the lower corner, with its headline following slightly behind so the two layers separate. Two trailing notches follow, a white kicker chip rises out from behind the band, and a sheen sweeps across once. At the end the text slides out of the band and the band wipes away.

templates.name: Wipe Slider Compare
templates.description: A large framed photo pair on a dark stage: a white divider with a glass handle is dragged from the right edge to far left, then overshoots back and settles past the middle. THEN (graded archival) and NOW labels are wiped by the divider and the frame collapses to a line on exit.

templates.name: Parallax Triptych
templates.description: Three tall panels rise into place from alternating sides with masked reveals while the pictures inside counter-move. A single photo is sliced across all three and snaps into alignment. Panels drift at different pan speeds, carry numbered captions, and close away staggered.

templates.name: 3D Photo Carousel
templates.description: Photos on a 3D ring spin in and land with the front card enlarged and lit and a floor reflection below. The ring then steps one photo at a time with a mono counter and caption swapping letter by letter, and spins away at the end.

templates.name: Corkboard Pins
templates.description: On a warm speckled cork board with a slow camera drift, a taped index card with a marker title lands first. Photo prints then drop in with closing shadows, a pin falls into each, and each print swings on its pin before settling into a faint sway; everything is yanked off the board at the end.

templates.name: Double Exposure
templates.description: A graded base photo slowly pushes while a second photo (or a mirrored copy) is screen-blended in through a travelling diagonal mask. An accent light leak sweeps and flickers across the frame, and the look exits in a burn-out flash under a bottom-left title.

templates.name: Zoom Through
templates.description: Photo 1 settles, then a bordered window pops open at its centre with cyan finder brackets and a rolling ZOOM readout. The camera dives in with motion blur and a flash until photo 2 fills the frame, and the title rises bottom-left.

templates.name: Annotated Photo
templates.description: A photo is swept by a cyan scan line that leaves a faint grid behind. Numbered markers pop with pulsing rings, curved white arrows draw on to them with arrowheads snapping in, and condensed labels with detail lines rise beside each; the arrows undraw on exit.

templates.name: Grid Pop Mosaic
templates.description: A 2x2 (or 3x2) photo grid pops in diagonally with back-out scale, tilt and a camera-flash flicker per cell. The gutters then close as the grid grows into a full-bleed mosaic, a centred title rises over a soft dark pool, and the cells flip away in 3D at the end.

templates.name: Parallax Depth Stack
templates.description: Three layers: a blurred dark back photo, a large mid card and a white-bordered front print that flies in from near the lens. They truck sideways at three speeds with drifting dust motes and an accent light beam, then the camera pushes through the layers on exit.

templates.name: Photo Date Plate
templates.description: A photo is wiped on behind a glowing accent edge (archival grade for older years) and crop marks draw into the corners. A dark angled plate backed by an accent plate slides over the bottom-right corner while the year rolls in as an odometer, then both plates slide back out.

templates.name: Numbered Cascade
templates.description: Paper-white numbered cards fall one after another into a diagonal cascade, tilted back in 3D with shadows tightening as they land, an accent number block and words rising out of masks, a sheen sweeping each card, then folding away in turn.

templates.name: Checklist Ticks
templates.description: A checklist on the left of the footage: rows rise in, each box draws its outline, then in sequence a box fills with the accent, a tick draws through it with a ripple, the row brightens and a progress bar counts it up.

templates.name: Pros And Cons
templates.description: Two columns split by a divider drawing from the centre, a green plus badge and a red minus badge spinning in over tinted columns, the points landing left, right, left, right with little plus and minus rings drawing on as the words rise.

templates.name: Top Five Countdown
templates.description: A giant rank numeral rolls 5 to 1 with motion blur while ranked rows slide in from the bottom of the list upward, values rolling, and number one lands last in an enlarged top slot with an accent wipe and glow flash as the others dim.

templates.name: Icon Bullet Grid
templates.description: A crosshair draws out from the centre to split a 2x2 grid, then clockwise each cell's geometric line icon (drop, bolt, house, coin, warning, leaf or a plain shape) draws on and fills with a rippling accent liquid as its label and line rise beside it.

templates.name: Process Chevrons
templates.description: Interlocking chevrons draw their outlines left to right, then light up in turn as the accent pours through each, the active step lifting with a glow and its label brightening below, finished by a sheen running through the whole row.

templates.name: Cycle Loop
templates.description: Three to five numbered nodes pop in round a ring, arcs draw between them and grow arrowheads, accent dashes then flow round the loop while a comet circles and lights each node it passes, a dashed outer ring turning slowly around the centred title.

templates.name: Pyramid Levels
templates.description: On the dark case-file desktop a pyramid builds bottom-up, each shaded trapezoid level dropping and settling onto the one below with a flash line, the apex in the accent, and dashed leaders drawing out to labels that rise beside each level.

templates.name: Funnel Stages
templates.description: On a drifting graphite gradient mesh a funnel's stage outlines draw, then the accent pours down through it stage by stage with a bright leading edge, each value rolling as the pour reaches it, labels rising on the left and red drop-off pills popping between stages on the right.

templates.name: Tab Reveal
templates.description: An accordion of white tabs slides in on the right of the footage and opens one tab at a time, its chevron turning and number chip going accent while its lines rise and a progress bar runs along its foot, then folds shut as the next one opens.

templates.name: Giant Quote Marks
templates.description: Oversized drawn accent quote marks spin and scale in over a faint drifting ghost mark, the quote rises line by line out of masks with key words in the accent, then the speaker slides out beside a drawn accent rule as the closing mark rotates in.

templates.name: Testimony Rail
templates.description: On a dark designed backdrop, an accent rail draws down with a glowing tip. Each quote line slides out of the rail as the tip passes it, tick marks light up, and the speaker's name and role rise at the foot beside a diamond node that keeps pulsing.

templates.name: Pull-Quote Panel
templates.description: A frosted glass panel slides in from the right over the playing footage with a parallax lag. Its accent edge draws down, a quote mark pops, the words rise one by one with key words in the accent, and the speaker rises under a hairline before the panel slides back out.

templates.name: Statement Vs Reality
templates.description: The official statement rises word by word. Two rules then draw outward as a bouncing accent BUT drops between them with a soft flash and a camera punch, the statement dims and shrinks, and the reality rises letter by letter in big accent capitals.

templates.name: Strike Correction
templates.description: A claim rises under a small CLAIM tag and a red bar strikes through each line, led by a hot white spark. The claim shakes, dims and moves up, and the correction rises letter by letter in large capitals beneath an accent kicker.

templates.name: Karaoke Highlight
templates.description: The sentence rises in white. Each word then fills left to right with the accent in speaking rhythm (longer words take longer), lifting slightly with a glowing underline that trails off, and the speaker is tagged beneath.

templates.name: Emphasis Zoom Word
templates.description: A sentence rises in big condensed capitals and the key word's underline charges. The camera then dives into that word with motion blur while the rest fall away, the word turns accent, and focus brackets snap around it during a slow push.

templates.name: Said-By Stamp
templates.description: The quote rises word by word. A circular seal then slams down from above with a camera shake, a shock ring and a burst of sparks; the speaker's name runs round its ring and the seal keeps turning slowly.

templates.name: Double Quote Cards
templates.description: Two cards rise showing their accent backs, then flip over in 3D one after the other with a spring settle and shading to reveal two short opposing quotes. A light sheen crosses each card and the speakers appear under hairlines, then the cards flip away.

templates.name: Whisper Subtitle
templates.description: A cinematic lowercase line sits low on the footage. Letters rise from the centre outward while wide tracking closes in, a hairline draws out from a glowing accent dot, and the speaker appears below in small spaced capitals before the line tracks back out.

templates.name: Chapter Number Roll
templates.description: On a dark card with a pulsing accent glow, a huge two-digit chapter number spins into place on odometer wheels, an accent rule grows beside it as the kicker and title rise letter by letter, and a thin segmented progress line draws across the bottom with the current chapter filling in the accent.

templates.name: Part Divider
templates.description: Over drifting navy dotted ridges, two fine rules draw outward from the centre, the top one framing a tracked PART II label and the bottom one a popping accent diamond, with the title rising letter by letter between them and the rules retracting to the centre at the end.

templates.name: Episode Card
templates.description: A dark gradient card flips in on a 3D turn over the darkened footage, its big outline episode number drawing on stroke by stroke with an accent glow, the title rising beside it and a light sheen sweeping across the card before it flips away.

templates.name: Letterbox Title
templates.description: Black cinema bars slide in from the top and bottom over the playing footage, the title rises letter by letter in the gap and slowly tracks wider, with a kicker in the top bar and a subtitle in the bottom bar, then the bars slide away.

templates.name: Glitch Resolve Title
templates.description: Over darkened footage, the title appears as jittering cyan and accent RGB-split slices with a scan line and brief scanlines, then snaps into a clean title within about half a second and holds clean, with a mono kicker, an accent rule and a subtitle rising in.

templates.name: Chrome Light Sweep
templates.description: In a dark studio under a drifting spotlight, a chrome title with an accent rim rises line by line while its tracking closes up, a glossy light band sweeps across the letters twice, and its reflection fades into the floor below.

templates.name: Chapter Fraction
templates.description: Low-left over the footage, a big 02 and a smaller 05 spin into place on digit wheels while an accent slash draws between them and chapter segments pop in beneath, with the current one filling, and the kicker and title rise letter by letter beside a growing divider.

templates.name: Coordinates Title
templates.description: Low-left over the footage, a mini dark globe spins and tilts onto the place while targeting brackets close in and lock in the accent, a pin pulses, and beside it the place kicker and title rise as a mono lat/lon readout scrambles in cyan and locks digit by digit to the true coordinates.

templates.name: Year Tape Title
templates.description: On a light warm-grey card, a mechanical year counter rolls up through the decades to the year while a timeline tape of year ticks scrolls under an accent needle, then the title rises letter by letter beneath with an accent rule.

templates.name: Countdown to Chapter
templates.description: A 3-2-1 countdown with rolling numerals inside a ring, an accent arc and radar wedge sweeping each count over a rotating tick dial, then a shockwave and particle burst as the ring shrinks into an emblem holding the chapter number above the title, which rises letter by letter.

templates.name: Marker Circle Pulse
templates.description: A gold marker loop draws a little more than one full turn around the subject so its ends overlap like a real pen stroke, bumps as it closes and sends out soft pulse rings, while a short kicker and title rise letter by letter beside it on a white tick.

templates.name: Pigtail Arrow Label
templates.description: The label rises in first, then an accent arrow draws out of it on a bowed curve with a looping pigtail, its head flicks open at the end and a ring bursts on the target point before the arrow retracts at the exit.

templates.name: Measured Bracket
templates.description: A crisp white square bracket grows outward from its centre beside a region with fine ruler ticks and a faint accent wash; an accent notch points to the label, an optional value rolls like an odometer and a gold highlight keeps sliding along the spine.

templates.name: Target Lock Reticle
templates.description: A large reticle turned 45 degrees hunts across the subject between seeded guesses, settles, snaps shut and blinks gold to lock; cyan crosshair lines shoot out, a range ring turns, the mono status flips from SCANNING to TARGET LOCKED and the coordinates decode digit by digit.

templates.name: Dimension Line
templates.description: End ticks snap in and dashed witness lines reach toward the object, then a dimension line shoots out from the centre with gold arrowheads riding its ends; the value rolls above it (or beside it when label is vertical/height/depth), the caption rises below and a laser dot keeps sweeping along the line.

templates.name: Water Drop Ripple
templates.description: A gold drop falls onto the point, squashes into a marker dot and sends perspective-flattened water ripples across the surface; a leader line climbs to an elbow and runs out under the label, the title rising above the line and the subtitle dropping in below it.

templates.name: Typing Quote Bubble
templates.description: A small white bubble with three bouncing typing dots springs out of the speaker, then morphs open into a clean minimal quote bubble with a curved tail; the words rise in line by line behind a gold accent bar under the speaker's name, and the bubble shrinks back into the speaker at the end.

templates.name: Marker Scribble Underline
templates.description: A short statement rises in big condensed caps letter by letter, then a three-pass gold marker scribble tears back and forth under the key word and keeps a subtle hand-drawn line boil while it holds before it erases in stroke order.

templates.name: Searchlight Spotlight
templates.description: The frame dims and desaturates while a soft pool of light sweeps in from off the subject, tightens onto it and gently breathes; a gold ring draws around the pool, the label steps out on an elbow line and at the end the iris opens back to the full picture.

templates.name: Swinging Fact Chips
templates.description: A connector climbs from a pulsing dot on the subject to a joint, a spine drops from it and two or three white key/value chips swing down one after another on a springy 3D hinge with their numbers rolling, then fold back up in reverse at the end.

templates.name: Times Bigger Bars
templates.description: A grey reference bar lands, a dashed guide drops from its end, then an accent bar grows notch by notch (x1, x2, x3 markers rising as the glowing head passes) to N times its length and a big 'xN' odometer rolls in beside it.

templates.name: Fraction Pie
templates.description: A pie outlined into its slices pops in with a rotating dotted rim; the counted slices fly in radially one by one with a back-out snap while a stacked numerator-over-denominator fraction rolls and the title rises letter by letter.

templates.name: KPI Flip Grid
templates.description: Up to four dark glass KPI tiles flip in on the Y axis one after another in 3D, each with an accent edge, rising label, rolling value, a filling hairline meter and a light sheen, then flip away at the end.

templates.name: Before After Slider
templates.description: A panel opens like a barn door showing the 'before' value; a white slider handle sweeps across and wipes the red- or green-tinted 'after' state over it while the new number rolls, then a struck-through 'WAS' line and a change pill appear.

templates.name: Change Meter
templates.description: Low-left on the footage, a red-to-green minus/plus scale unfolds from zero, then a white needle springs with overshoot to the percent change, lighting the ticks it passes while the signed value rolls above it.

templates.name: Dual Dial Gauges
templates.description: Two 270-degree speedometer dials sit side by side; each arc and needle springs up in turn with the ticks lighting as the fill passes, the needles keep a faint quiver, and the values roll in the open base of each dial.

templates.name: Spotlight Podium
templates.description: On a dark stage with a perspective floor grid, the 3rd, 2nd and 1st podium blocks rise out of the floor with a back-out bounce, then a spotlight snaps on over the accent-colored winner with a ray burst and drifting dust while the values roll above.

templates.name: Tug of War
templates.description: A braided rope draws outward from the centre between two labeled sides; the knot and its accent pennant jitter at the centre line, then are hauled by a spring toward the bigger value as the braid slides, and the winning share rolls in under the knot with a direction chevron.

templates.name: Goal Track
templates.description: A track draws on while a goal flag is hoisted and waves at the finish; a glowing runner streaks along to the share of the goal, 25/50/75% milestones ping as it passes, a percent chip rides above it and the amount rolls in the headline.

templates.name: Stacked Blocks
templates.description: Accent blocks (up to 50, one per unit or a nice unit each) drop with gravity and stack row by row into a grid, squashing as they land, while the counter beside them rolls in sync; a light sweep then glides across the finished stack.

templates.name: Polaroid Drop
templates.description: A polaroid falls onto a dark lamp-lit desk with rotation and a shadow that tightens as it nears, lands with a small bump, develops from grey-green emulsion to full colour, and its caption is handwritten letter by letter on the white margin (an optional second print lies underneath); it lifts off the desk at the end.

templates.name: 3D Tilt Card
templates.description: A thick photo block flips in from edge-on on a dotted navy stage and sways in 3D with parallax inside the frame, a gloss sweep, visible edges and a floor reflection, while the kicker, title and body rise beside it; it flips away edge-on at the end.

templates.name: Blinds Reveal
templates.description: Twelve dark vertical blind slats turn open left to right in perspective over a full-frame photo as it brightens and settles back, the caption lines rise out of their masks beside a growing accent bar, and the blinds close again right to left at the end.

templates.name: Spotlight Focus
templates.description: The photo sits almost black while a soft spotlight with dust drifting in its beam sweeps a searching curve and locks onto the subject (overlay.anchor or centre) with a tightening ring and accent ticks, a leader line draws to the label, and the light floods the whole frame at the end.

templates.name: Film Strip Pull
templates.description: A warm 35 mm film strip with sprocket holes and mono edge codes races in from the right with motion blur and stops on its centre frame, which is pulled out and enlarged into a bordered print while the strip dims and softens behind it; the caption rises below and everything races off to the left.

templates.name: Mosaic Assemble
templates.description: Over a blurred copy of itself, the photo builds from forty tiles flying in from the camera in a diagonal wave, tumbling in 3D and brightening as they land; the seams close, a gloss sweeps across, a frame with accent corners draws on, and the tiles scatter toward the camera at the end.

templates.name: Torn Paper Reveal
templates.description: A sheet of cream paper covering the frame tears away to a jagged torn edge with a white fibrous rim and a cast shadow, revealing the photo and leaving a paper panel where the ink title rises letter by letter with an accent rule and body lines; the panel slides off to the left at the end.

templates.name: Magnifier Lens
templates.description: A clean loupe with a light bezel and glass highlight glides in on an arc over the dimmed photo and enlarges the detail beneath it, the zoom pulling in as it lands (a mono x2.3 readout wipes open), with a dashed leader to the label; the lens slides away at the end.

templates.name: Scan ID Frame
templates.description: On a dark cyan HUD grid, corner brackets snap onto a portrait photo panel, a glowing scan line resolves the picture from cyan monochrome to colour, a detection box and ID tag lock on, the name rises letter by letter and mono readouts type in with a rolling metric and a segment bar; the screen collapses like a CRT switching off at the end.

templates.name: Ken Burns Vignette
templates.description: A full-frame photo fades up from black and pushes slowly in a direction chosen by the picture, under a teal-and-amber grade, soft vignette, fine film grain and sliding letterbox bars; a lower caption's kicker and title rise letter by letter above a drawn rule and accent diamond.

templates.name: Year Scroller Lens
templates.description: A ruler of years with quarter ticks races sideways under a glass magnifying lens, decelerates and clicks into the target year with a detent wobble, the year turning accent and underlined, then the ruler whooshes on as the lens shrinks away.

templates.name: Milestone Spine
templates.description: A glowing spine draws down the frame and, as its tip passes each milestone, the node pops accent with a ring and a card wipes out of the spine alternating left and right with the year and a line rising out of masks, folding back in at the end.

templates.name: Era Bands
templates.description: Eras wipe in as staggered bands along a year axis, then a NOW marker with a mono year readout sweeps left to right painting each band it crosses, the current era glowing accent and past eras turning white.

templates.name: Calendar Flip
templates.description: A desk calendar tilts up out of perspective and flips its pages over the binding in 3D, fast then slowing, through eleven earlier days, months or years to the date, which is then circled with a hand-drawn accent marker loop.

templates.name: Time Passing Clock
templates.description: A minimal clock face whose hands whirl many turns with an accent motion-trail fan and a rim filling up, then brake and settle with a wobble while the number rolls beside it with YEARS and LATER rising in letter by letter.

templates.name: Decade Roulette Grid
templates.description: Twelve decade cells pop in on a diagonal wave, an accent selector races round them like a roulette wheel and lands on the target decade, which fills with accent while a zoom cone opens onto its ten years with the exact year lit.

templates.name: Curved Path Events
templates.description: A glowing accent line draws along a winding S-shaped road with the camera easing after its head, each event node popping with a ring as it passes and its year and caption rising out of masks above or below the road, then the line erases away.

templates.name: Years Later Card
templates.description: A cinematic time-jump card on its own graphite backdrop: a hairline flashes and irises open into a letterboxed frame, fast-forward streaks rush past while the big number rolls, YEARS LATER rises in with tightening tracking, and the card collapses back into the hairline.

templates.name: Ink Date Stamp
templates.description: A round rubber stamp spins in large and slams onto the footage top right with a squash, shake, ink ring and splatter, its ring text and date printing letter by letter in rough speckled ink before it lifts away.

templates.name: Then Now Years
templates.description: The THEN year card flips in on a 3D hinge with its year rolling, an accent arrow crosses the gap popping a tick at every decade while the elapsed span counts up above it, and the NOW card flips in as the arrow arrives.

templates.name: Twin Lines
templates.description: Two smooth series lines (accent and cyan) draw left to right together behind a linked white scanner, the gap between them shades in, and each line ends in a pulsing dot with its name and rolling end value plus a GAP readout.

templates.name: Step Chart Flags
templates.description: A glowing stepped line draws across a dark grid; as the head passes each step a flag pole rises and a swallowtail value flag unfurls and gently waves (the last in the accent), then a green/red change pill pops in.

templates.name: Range Bars
templates.description: Rows of min-max ranges: each bar grows outward from its centre in a white-to-accent gradient while the hollow min dot and accent max dot slide apart carrying their counting values, the widest range highlighted with a pulsing ring.

templates.name: Stacked Stream
templates.description: A centred streamgraph whose smooth layered ribbons inflate one after another with a springy overshoot behind a glowing playhead that sweeps across reading out the year, ending with colour-keyed end values and layer names on the right.

templates.name: Donut Legend
templates.description: A thick multi-slice ring is swept clockwise by a glowing comet inside a slowly turning tick dial, each legend row wiping in and rolling its value the moment its slice is reached, then the largest slice pops outward with its share in the centre.

templates.name: Treemap Cut
templates.description: A squarified treemap whose tiles are cut in one after another by a glowing white knife edge, largest first, the biggest tile in the accent with a sheen sweep, labels and rolling values rising inside each tile and the total in the corner.

templates.name: Flow Split
templates.description: A sankey-lite: one trunk of flow pours left to right and splits along smooth curves into branches sized by value, light streaks running continuously inside each ribbon, branch nodes growing at the end with rolling values and shares.

templates.name: Scatter Bubbles
templates.description: Bubbles fly out of the centre on curved paths and land on a 2D grid with a ripple each, a dashed trend line draws through the cloud, and the highlighted point glows in the accent with crosshair lines and axis readout chips.

templates.name: Slope Chart
templates.description: Two axes (then and now) draw down, then each item's line draws across from its left dot to its right dot in green if it rose or red if it fell, landing with a ripple and a change label, a light spark running along the biggest mover.

templates.name: Radar Chart
templates.description: A spider web of 3-8 axes draws on ring by ring, a dashed reference polygon eases out, the accent value polygon springs out vertex by vertex with overshoot and breathes, and a translucent radar beam sweeps the web while axis labels and values rise in.

templates.name: Bar Race
templates.description: Horizontal bars start one after another and race: when a bigger bar overtakes, the rows glide into rank order, values count up at the bar ends, the current leader turns to the accent and an overtaking bar flashes a green chevron; the subtitle (a year) sits as a big ghost figure in the corner.

templates.name: Stacked Column Drop
templates.description: A wireframe 3D column draws on, then each share drops in from above as a solid shaded block that lands on the stack with a squash and a white edge flash, while leader lines draw from each block to its rolling percentage and name (a missing remainder becomes 'Other').

templates.name: Grouped Bars
templates.description: Pairs of columns per label: the 'then' bar is a hatched ghost whose outline draws on like a pen stroke, the 'now' bar rises solid in the accent beside it, both values roll above, and a red or green change chip pops over each pair, with a legend naming the two series from label 'A|B'.

templates.name: Lollipop Chart
templates.description: Rows of dotted tracks where each stem shoots out from zero with a bead on its tip, the head pops to full size with a shock ring on landing and the value rolls beside it, the highlighted row in the accent, then a cyan dashed AVG line drops through all rows.

templates.name: Dot Plot
templates.description: One long ruler draws on with its ticks popping as the line passes, then each value is a dot that slides from the left end to its mark with a comet trail, lands with a pulse ring and grows a thin stem to a tiered callout (rolling value and name) above or below the axis.

templates.name: Waterfall Chart
templates.description: A running total: the first item rises as a white starting column, each next item steps off the previous level up in green or down in red with its signed amount rising in, dashed connectors draw across between steps, and a final glowing accent column rises to the net total with a rolling figure.

templates.name: Bullet Target Chart
templates.description: Qualitative bands wipe open along a wide track, the white target marker drops in from above with a bounce, the accent value bar races toward it while the big number rolls, and a bracket draws the gap with a red 'SHORT' or green 'OVER' amount plus a percent-of-target readout.

templates.name: Radial Bars
templates.description: Concentric 270-degree rings sweep clockwise from twelve o'clock to each value with a bead on the tip and the live number riding just ahead of it, names sitting at each ring's start, the highlighted ring glowing in the accent with its figure rolling in the centre, and the rings unwind on exit.

templates.name: Heat Strip
templates.description: A row of year cells coloured from dark through the accent to white-hot flips up one after another on a bottom hinge like a departures board, each value rising inside its cell, then a light sweeps along the strip, the peak cell glows under a PEAK pointer and a gradient legend wipes in with the low and high ends.

templates.name: Histogram Wave
templates.description: Up to 24 thin columns rise in a left-to-right wave with a slight overshoot and then breathe in a slow travelling ripple, while the highlighted column turns to the accent and a leader line draws up from it to a callout with its rolling value and name; the columns sink back in a reverse wave at the end.

templates.name: Speedometer Gauge
templates.description: A 220-degree speedometer dial draws on, its ticks sweep in and light up as a tapered needle springs to the share with a slight overshoot and live wobble, while the figure rolls in under the pivot and the needle drops back to zero on exit.

templates.name: LED Digital Counter
templates.description: A dark seven-segment LED panel opens like a CRT from a bright line, flashes an 888 self-test, counts up to the figure with an amber glow, scanlines and a glass sheen, then powers off segment by segment and collapses back to a line.

templates.name: Split-Flap Counter
templates.description: Split-flap cards rise in and clatter through a full cycle of digits in 3D, slowing as each lands on the figure, the unit card flips in last, and the cards tip backwards one by one to exit.

templates.name: Countdown Dial
templates.description: A glowing ring charges full then drains backwards to the remaining share; the 60 bezel ticks dim as the pulsing head passes, the lost arc shows as dashed red, and the centre figure counts down from the total.

templates.name: Battery Level
templates.description: A battery outline draws on and charges full, then drains to the percentage while the fill shifts green to gold to red with a moving sheen and the percent counts beside it; low levels pulse a red warning, and label 'up' charges instead with a lightning bolt.

templates.name: Thermometer Rise
templates.description: A glass thermometer draws on beside a headline; the mercury springs up a degree scale, shifting from cool cyan through gold to heat red, the live reading rides the top of the column on a pointer, and a heat glow pulses round the bulb.

templates.name: Live Population Clock
templates.description: A lower-left tag on the footage: a cyan LIVE dot pulses, the big figure lands like an odometer and then keeps ticking upward digit by digit, with a data pulse running along its rule.

templates.name: Impact Number Burst
templates.description: A contracting ring and inward speed lines build tension, then the figure slams in from blur with a white flash, camera shake, two shockwave rings and a radial spark burst, and gold embers drift up while it holds.

templates.name: Segmented Meter
templates.description: Twenty slanted segments of rising height light in sequence with a bright leading edge, overshoot past the share and fall back like a VU meter while a white peak-hold segment drops after them, the figure rolling in above.

templates.name: Stopwatch Timer
templates.description: An analog stopwatch swings in, its crown clicks, the gold hand sweeps with an elapsed arc and a turning sub-dial while a mono chrono readout runs, then the crown clicks again and it stops on the duration with a pulse ring.

templates.name: Spinning Globe
templates.description: A lit orthographic globe with an atmosphere rim spins in from the west and eases onto the place while pushing in, the country tints in the accent, a map pin drops with a spring bounce, ripples roll out and a leader line draws to the place name, kicker and coordinates rising letter by letter.

templates.name: State Glow
templates.description: A dark US map where the camera eases toward the state holding the place, its outline draws on, then it fills from the bottom like a tank with a wavy bright-crested surface and glows while the other states dim, the state name rising letter by letter on the opposite side (falls back to the country outside the US).

templates.name: Arc Flight
templates.description: On a dark world map a great-circle arc lifts off the first place and draws to the second with a glowing comet head and fading trail over a faint dotted ground track, the distance (or value) rolls on an odometer at the apex and the destination bursts with rings as the head lands.

templates.name: Impact Radius
templates.description: A zone snaps open around the place at its true radius on a dark vector map, the land inside tints in the accent, a range dial of ticks writes itself around the edge and slowly turns, sonar rings run out to the boundary and a measured radius line carries the rolling value + unit.

templates.name: Choropleth Lift
templates.description: Several states (or countries) shaded from slate to the accent by their item values rise off the dark map one by one as extruded 3D blocks, taller for bigger values, each value rolling on top while a needle on the gradient legend slides to that value.

templates.name: Pinboard List
templates.description: Numbered accent badge pins fall onto a dark map one after another with a spring bounce and ground ripple, and at the same beat the matching numbered row of a list on the left rises out of its mask and takes the accent highlight.

templates.name: Coordinate HUD
templates.description: A cyan targeting screen: a scan line sweeps the grid, a full-frame crosshair slides onto the place while mono LAT/LON readouts tick toward its coordinates and the outline map zooms in, then the reticle closes, squares up and locks in the accent with a flash before the name rises beside it.

templates.name: River Draw
templates.description: On a dark dotted-ridge backdrop with frosted-glass land, a meandering glowing line draws through every place in order with bright water dashes streaming downstream along it, waypoints pop as the head passes, and the start and end are named with the value rolling at the end.

templates.name: Country Spotlight
templates.description: The world map dims under an accent spotlight while the country holding the place lifts off the sheet toward the camera with a 3D tilt and growing shadow, leaving a dashed hole behind, floats large with a pulsing pin, and drops back into its hole at the end.

templates.name: Zoom Box Inset
templates.description: A country (or lower-48) outline draws on at left, a focus box draws around the place, then the box itself flies out along dashed connectors and grows into a large magnified inset on the right with a fine lat/lon grid, scale bar and a dropping pin, shrinking back into the box at the end.

templates.name: Ink Bleed Title
templates.description: Black ink blooms over the shot from three points with crinkled, creeping edges and a soft wet spread until it fills the frame, the title rises letter by letter in white under a gold kicker and rule, then the ink opens from the centre with the same ragged edge and gives the picture back.

templates.name: Anamorphic Light Streak
templates.description: An anamorphic light streak with a white core, gold glow, hot spot and hexagonal lens ghosts sweeps across the footage and its light writes the title letter by letter as it passes; a weaker glint sweeps back at the end and lifts the letters away.

templates.name: Floating Dust Motes
templates.description: Soft dust motes at three depths (far specks, mid motes, near bokeh) drift and rise slowly through a warm shaft of light over the footage, flaring as they cross the beam, with an optional source line and year rising low left beside a gold rule.

templates.name: HUD Grid Scan
templates.description: A thin HUD grid draws out from the centre over the footage with closing corner brackets and a top ruler, a cyan scan line with a phosphor trail sweeps down and up lighting the grid crossings it passes, mono readouts type in, and the subject rises low left under its typed coordinates.

templates.name: Film Burn Flash
templates.description: Warm light floods in from the right edge with flicker and a light leak, then the film burns through with a white-hot hole, charred rim, glowing edge and flying embers before fading back to the shot, while an optional date or era rises letter by letter low left.

templates.name: Geometric Shape Wipe
templates.description: Skewed bars and triangles in ink, gold and white whip across the frame as a staggered group with a smeared motion blur, and the trailing gold dash parks as the underline of an optional word that rises low left, then whips out with it at the end.

templates.name: Gradient Mesh Title
templates.description: A slow gold, slate and charcoal gradient mesh blooms open from the centre through a soft circular edge and keeps drifting with a sheen crossing it, while a centred title rises letter by letter with its kicker, split gold rule and subtitle.

templates.name: Glitch Slice Burst
templates.description: Three short digital bursts slice the picture into horizontal bands shifted sideways with cyan and gold colour splits, a double image, an inverted band, block artefacts and scanlines, while an optional alert line rises low left and jitters colour-split with each burst.

templates.name: Speed Line Tunnel
templates.description: Tapered speed lines stream from the edges into the centre with a white and gold impact ring and a flash, settling to a steady drift while a short line punches in letter by letter with a scale slam inside the clear zone, then the lines rush in and vanish.

templates.name: Paper Tear Reveal
templates.description: A sheet of textured paper slides up over the shot with the title printed on it, cracks along a jagged line with a shudder and tears into two halves that hinge open and fly apart with white fibrous edges, shadows and scraps, revealing the footage beneath.

templates.name: Place Time Stamp
templates.description: A thriller-style location stamp low on the left of the footage shows the place in heavy condensed caps, the date and time beneath and the map pin's coordinates in mono; each letter rises in behind an accent cursor bar that leads the reveal row by row and keeps blinking until the letters drop away.

templates.name: True Events Card
templates.description: A 'Based on true events' card on black film grain: small, widely spaced caps rise letter by letter from the centre outward while the spacing slowly opens, the word TRUE warms to the accent under a flickering projector light, and a place line follows beneath.

templates.name: Letterbox Caption
templates.description: Cinematic 2.39:1 bars slide over the footage with a glint along their inner edges and a filmic grade; an anamorphic streak crosses as a sentence-case caption rises word by word in the lower picture, with a small place line in the top bar, then the bars pull away.

templates.name: B&W Flash Intro
templates.description: A camera flash hits and the footage drops to grainy black and white; the person's name whips out of its mask leaning with its speed, the role follows behind a growing accent rule, and a softer second flash brings the colour back as the words slide away.

templates.name: Focus Vignette Line
templates.description: A heavy iris vignette closes in and blurs the edges of the footage like tunnel vision; one line rises letter by letter in the clear centre, its key word warming to the accent and a hairline drawing beneath, then the iris opens again.

templates.name: Spotlight Sweep Title
templates.description: On a dark stage a hanging lamp flickers on and its dusty beam sweeps left to right, each letter of the title rising as the light reaches it; the beam swings back, widens over the whole title and cuts out with a flicker at the end.

templates.name: Slow Drift Quote
templates.description: A quote rises word by word on near-black between accent quotation marks while the block slowly drifts and pushes in, dust motes float past at several depths with two wandering soft lights, and the speaker appears between accent hairlines.

templates.name: To Be Continued
templates.description: A thin white chevron and a thick accent chevron sweep across the frame and uncover an end card where an arrow plate draws on around the words, its solid accent tip snaps in and three chevrons pulse onward, before the same arrow sweeps it all away.

templates.name: Sources Credit Roll
templates.description: A credits-style roll of sources on dark: under a SOURCES heading, what was used (left) and who it came from (right) roll up through a soft window, each reference number lighting in the accent as its row crosses the reading line, then every row rises out of its mask.

templates.name: Chapter Progress Bar
templates.description: A thin chapter progress bar draws across the top of the footage; finished chapters fill white one by one, the current segment lifts and fills in the accent behind a pulsing playhead, and the chapter number rolls in beneath with its title.

templates.name: Social Post Card
templates.description: A generic dark post card tilts up out of perspective while the avatar's accent ring draws and the post rises line by line (highlight phrase in the accent, hashtags in cyan), an attached still wipes open, then the heart is tapped with a squash, ring and spark burst and the like count rolls up.

templates.name: Comment Thread
templates.description: A comments panel unfolds under an optional heading with the comment count rolling; the top comment pops in, then thread lines draw down to each reply as it lands with an accent flash, its words rising out of their masks.

templates.name: Search Bar Typing
templates.description: A white search bar stretches open under a letter-by-letter kicker, the query types in mono with a human rhythm, suggestions drop with the typed part light and the completion bold, a selection steps down to the pick, enter ripples, the dropdown folds and the results count rolls.

templates.name: Notification Stack
templates.description: On the footage's right side, phone notifications drop in one after another with a buzz under a NOTIFICATIONS header whose count badge ticks up, each pushing the older ones down until the oldest tucks behind the stack; emergency wording gets a red alert icon.

templates.name: Chat Bubbles
templates.description: A chat panel swings up; typing dots bounce in each sender's bubble (the header reads typing…), then the bubble grows into the message left in grey or right in the accent, the thread scrolls to keep up and a read tick draws under the last reply.

templates.name: Phone News Screen
templates.description: On a dark studio backdrop a phone rises out of the frame in 3D and its screen wakes on a generic news story rising line by line; then the phone turns aside and the story slides out from behind it as a large white card, the key words swept with the accent marker.

templates.name: Browser Article
templates.description: On the dark case desktop a generic browser swings in, the address types in mono, a load bar races, the article builds line by line and scrolls to the key sentence; a cursor arcs down and clicks it, the accent marker sweeps across it and the camera pushes in.

templates.name: Video Player Chrome
templates.description: Player chrome rides on the footage: the title and channel rise top-left, a play button pops in the centre and clears, the scrubber seeks along a chaptered bar to the timestamp as the mono time counts and keeps playing, and a hover preview with the chapter name rises over the playhead.

templates.name: Email Open
templates.description: An inbox lands with the unread message between two others; the row glows, is clicked and morphs open into the full email (subject, sender, date), the body rises line by line and the accent marker sweeps the key line while a reply button pops.

templates.name: Poll Results
templates.description: A poll card rises with the question; the options land as radio rows, one is tapped with a ripple, then every bar fills to its share with its percentage rolling, the winner tinted in the accent with a check popping, and the vote total rolls beneath.

templates.name: Water Drop Fill
templates.description: Compact low-left tag on the footage: a water-drop icon draws on, a droplet falls in through its tip and splashes, then the drop fills to the percentage with a live wavy surface and rising bubbles while a gauge marker climbs and the number rolls beside it.

templates.name: House Grid
templates.description: Data card: up to forty house icons land in a diagonal wave on street lines, then the counted share switches on in a scattered order, each house flickering on with a warm glow, while '1 IN 3' (or the percent, or value of total) rolls beside it with a legend.

templates.name: Traffic Queue
templates.description: Compact low-left tag: the count rolls above a short two-lane road that fades into the footage; cars race in with speed streaks and brake into a queue at a stop line with accent tail lamps flaring, the jam creeps forward, then clears out through the fade.

templates.name: Dollar Pulse
templates.description: Compact low-left tag: a dark coin badge with the currency sign pops in and beats like a heart, with a ring and a glow on each beat, while an ECG trace draws under the rolling amount and carries every beat along it as an accent pulse.

templates.name: Calendar Tear-Off
templates.description: Compact low-right tag: a tear-off day pad rises in and its pages rip away one after another, blowing off into the picture in 3D (slow, fast, slow), until the day count is left on top with an accent underline; the words and a weeks or years conversion rise beside it.

templates.name: Hourglass Flip
templates.description: Compact low-right tag: an hourglass pops in upside down and flips over with an overshoot, then its accent sand runs for the whole hold (a funnel dip, falling grains, a growing mound) beside the rolling time figure.

templates.name: Power Bolt
templates.description: Compact low-left tag: a lightning-bolt icon draws on beside the power figure and charges up from its tip with crackling arcs while the number rolls; when full it flashes white with a ring and a burst of rays, then hums with a breathing glow and a band of current.

templates.name: Fire Flicker
templates.description: Compact low-left tag: a spark ignites a layered flame (red tongues, gold body, white core) that licks on its own rhythms and throws rising embers, while the burned-area figure rolls beside it over a burn line with a travelling spark head.

templates.name: Crowd Swell
templates.description: Compact low-right tag: the head count rolls while a crowd of fifty person pictograms gathers beneath it from the front centre outward, row behind row, each figure popping up with an accent flash and then shifting on its feet; a legend says how many people one figure stands for.

templates.name: Factory Smoke
templates.description: Compact low-right tag: a factory line icon rises out of a ground line, its chimneys pop up and its windows flicker on in the accent, then soft smoke puffs swell, rise and drift off into the picture while the emission figure rolls beside it.

templates.name: Split Statement
templates.description: Own-backdrop card: a graphite half and a paper half slide in from the sides and lock on a diagonal accent seam that flashes and keeps a spark running up it, each side's statement (items[0] and items[1]: label as the headline, text as the line beneath; or text vs subtitle) rising letter by letter, then the halves part like doors.

templates.name: Balance Scale
templates.description: A metal balance builds from its base, weights stack onto both pans in proportion to the two item values, then the beam tips toward the heavier side on a damped spring while both values roll under the pans and a chip names the heavier side and the ratio.

templates.name: Venn Overlap
templates.description: Two white rings draw on apart and slide together on a spring; their overlap fills with the accent like rising water with a settling wave and the shared thing (text, or highlight) rises inside it, while each set's name (items[0], items[1] with optional text) sits in its own crescent.

templates.name: Tick Table
templates.description: A comparison table whose rows (items, marks in text like 'yes|no|partial') rise in under drawn hairlines, then a scan line runs down each column (names in label 'A|B') popping accent ticks, grey crosses or half discs, and the column with the most ticks lights up as the scores roll in.

templates.name: Myth vs Fact
templates.description: A tri-vision board: a graphite MYTH card with the claim (text) and a red cross drawing beside it turns over slat by slat in a 3D wave to its paper FACT side with the correction (subtitle) and an accent tick popping in, then the slats turn edge-on and vanish.

templates.name: Spectrum Marker
templates.description: A pale-to-accent spectrum band draws in under a fine ruler, a lens marker springs along it to value/total while the reading rolls in a callout above the needle, and the zone under it (item labels, evenly split or item values as upper bounds) lights in the accent.

templates.name: Quadrant Matrix
templates.description: A 2x2 matrix builds from its centre cross with its quadrant names; a dot flies from the origin on a curved trail into the spot set by items[0] (x axis name + score) and items[1] (y axis name + score), lands with a shockwave and floods its quadrant, while the subject (label), both scores and a verdict chip roll in beside it.

templates.name: Then-Now Morph
templates.description: One disc sized by area morphs from THEN to NOW through 2-4 items while the big number's digits roll straight from one value into the next and the era label (item label) rolls over, the THEN size left as a dashed ghost ring with the lost or gained band hatched red or green, a timeline marker walking the stages and a change chip landing.

templates.name: Mirror Bars
templates.description: A butterfly chart: a centre column of category labels (items label) with one group's bars growing left (value) and the other's growing right (text as a number), group names from label 'A|B', values rolling at the bar ends and a light sheen passing, then the bars retract into the column.

templates.name: Photo Versus
templates.description: Own-backdrop card: two photo cards (media[0], media[1]) swing in turned toward each other in 3D, a V and an S slam together between them with a shockwave, streaks and a short camera shake, an accent divider draws through the gap and name plates (items labels, with item text or value beneath) wipe open under each picture.

templates.name: Breaking Flag
templates.description: / A red broadcast tab pops in the top-left corner; the white BREAKING panel swings out of it on a hinge, then the dark headline panel swings out of that one (each shaded while it is turned away). At the end they fold back in reverse and the tab closes. /

templates.name: Alert Toast
templates.description: / A push alert: a frosted card springs in from the right edge (a ghost of an earlier alert stacked behind it), the app icon pops and rings, title and message rise line by line, a timer bar drains until it slides away. /

templates.name: Siren Badge
templates.description: / A siren emblem low-left: the ring draws, the dome glows and double-flashes like a strobe, wail rings spread, and a two-lamp red beam sweeps round across the footage. The kicker, the label (letter by letter) and a line of context sit beside it. /

templates.name: Warning Polygon
templates.description: / A storm-based warning on a radar map: a scan line sweeps and reveals the echoes drifting with the storm, the straight-edged warning polygon draws itself vertex by vertex, hatches in and pulses, a motion arrow shows where it is heading; the warning type, its end time and the areas stack beside. /

templates.name: Severity Meter
templates.description: / A level on a 1-5 scale: a staircase of blocks springs up, a charge climbs it (each step flashing as it lights) under a sliding pointer, the level's block fills and breathes - red when the level is in the top of the scale - while the level number rolls and its name rises beside it. /

templates.name: Countdown Timer
templates.description: / Time running out: mono digits in glass cells rise in, then tick in real time from the value - each changed digit rolls up out of its cell, the colons blink, a red pulse runs under the row on every second, and the last ten seconds turn red. /

templates.name: Live Tag
templates.description: / A live bug top-right: a white LIVE chip wipes open with a beating red dot, a divider draws, the place rises letter by letter over an accent rule and the local time ticks by the second, each changed digit rolling. /

templates.name: Emergency Stamp
templates.description: / A proclamation slides up onto a dark desk (a seal drawing itself, the title letter by letter, the text beneath); the DECLARED stamp drops from above with its shadow and slams down - the camera shakes, the ink bleeds a little, specks spray and dust puffs out - a double impression ghosts in, the sig

templates.name: Slim Ticker
templates.description: / A slim dark-glass ticker low on the frame (inset, never a red band): the accent chip springs up, the bar extends out of it with the sentence already crawling, a light runs along its top edge; at the end the bar retracts into the chip, taking the text with it. /

templates.name: Storm Track
templates.description: / A storm (or any threat) moving over a vector coastline: the widening cone and the dashed track draw from the first place to the last behind the storm symbol, spinning the way storms turn in that hemisphere; each place pops as it is passed, its label rising outside the cone; the category rolls in a

templates.name: Evidence Bag
templates.description: / value = item number, text = description, label = case number, subtitle = where it was collected, items = chain of custody (label who, text when). The story's still (media) sits inside the bag as a print. /

templates.name: Case Stamp
templates.description: / text = the case title, label (or value) = the case number, subtitle = the department line, highlight = an optional word stamped in red (UNSOLVED). /

templates.name: Redacted Doc
templates.description: / highlight = the key line (revealed), text = the document heading (or the key line when no highlight), body = the surrounding text (mostly redacted), subtitle = the issuing office, label = a date or file reference. /

templates.name: Fingerprint Scan
templates.description: / value = the match (percent by default), text = the result line, label = the print's name, subtitle = the database. No value: the result alone, big. /

templates.name: Police Log
templates.description: / items = log entries (label the time, text the event), text = the log's title, subtitle = the unit or date. The entries type in on a console. /

templates.name: Unknown Silhouette
templates.description: / label = the headline word (default UNIDENTIFIED), text = who they are, subtitle = a small line above (last seen...), items = the known details. /

templates.name: Evidence Markers
templates.description: / media[0] = the scene photo, items = what each marker points out (label), text = the legend title, subtitle = the place. No items: three markers. /

templates.name: Phone Records
templates.description: / items = calls (label the time, text the caller, value the duration in seconds), highlight = the call to flag, text = what it was, subtitle = whose phone. The flagged call's time and duration roll out beside it. /

templates.name: Cctv Frame
templates.description: / On the footage: label = the camera id, text = the location, subtitle = the date and time ("03-03-2014 23:41:07"); the clock ticks from that time (or counts from 00:00:00 when none is given). /

templates.name: Transcript
templates.description: / items = the exchange (label the speaker, text the words), text = the transcript title, subtitle = when / which case, highlight = the phrase to mark. No items: text becomes one entry spoken by label (a quote). /

templates.name: Water Cycle
templates.description: / The water cycle on its own designed landscape: mountains rise, the sea line draws, then the four stages arrive in turn (vapour arrows rising off the sea, an arc carrying it to the cloud as the cloud puffs out, rain falling on the peaks, the river and an arrow running back to the sea). Once the loo

templates.name: Aquifer Drop
templates.description: / The ground in section. A bright cut line sweeps down and reveals the strata (topsoil, clay, the aquifer's gravel, bedrock); the saturated aquifer glows cyan below the water table (the hydrologist's ▽ on it). The table then sinks by the value (label "up": rises), the lost band hatched red behind it

templates.name: Pipe Flow
templates.description: / A pipeline on a blueprint. The pipe draws on, the gate valve's wheel spins it open and water floods the empty pipe from the left, a bright front leading it; each station (items: label, text) lights with a ping as the water reaches it. When the water reaches the inline turbine meter its rotor spins

templates.name: Molecule Orbit
templates.description: / A molecule built from the formula in overlay.label (or one found in the text): the central atom pops, its partners fly in from depth and their bonds snap on while the model swings into 3D; three tilted electron orbits draw on and electrons whip round them, passing in front of and behind the atoms.

templates.name: Cause Chain
templates.description: / Two to five consequences as hexagon nodes in a row, dashed links between them. The outlines draw on, then a spark leaves the first node (CAUSE) and runs down each link, the lit line growing behind it; when it arrives the arrowhead snaps on and the next node ignites (fills with the accent, a hexago

templates.name: Reservoir Levels
templates.description: / Reservoirs as valley cross-sections carved side by side into a ground slab. The outlines draw on, then each basin fills to its share of capacity (the level solved for area, so 50% sits above half depth, as in a real valley) with a slosh that dies away; the percentage rolls above each, turning red

templates.name: Warming Stripes
templates.description: / The "show your stripes" graphic as a full-frame backdrop: one stripe per year (items, interpolated when few, or a warming curve built from the value), deep blue through white to red. The stripes grow up out of the axis behind a scanning playhead with a light at its edge that reads out the year; a

templates.name: Rain Gauges
templates.description: / Two to five graduated glass rain gauges land in a row.
